notes: Version 2.52 records white paper 3.17, Q6a 2.7 and O18 2.1. White-paper Proposition A.1 is restated: for a fixed principal connection over a connected base, trivial holonomy is equivalent to a global horizontal section, so any nontrivial holonomy, of any dimension, excludes such a section. Holonomy decides neither the topological triviality of the bundle nor the existence of gauge transformations: a trivial bundle can carry a connection with full U(1) holonomy, and a flat trivial bundle still admits nontrivial gauge transformations. Appendix B.23, the Q6a remark on the holonomy argument and the two O18 motivation passages now ground the exclusion of fibre gauge structure under injectivity on injectivity itself, in the principal-bundle setting. Proposition 5.3 and Theorem A.1 are unchanged. No paper status, graph node or edge changes.
